topic: Energos Freeze FSRU deployment and commissioning of the Manzanillo Power Land plant
wiki_text: The 125,000 m3 FSRU Energos Freeze (chartered/operated by New Fortress Energy) arrived in Manzanillo Bay, Montecristi, on 31 August 2025 and docked 1 September 2025, with the first LNG cargo for commissioning delivered in early January 2026. The associated 414 MW Energia 2000 'Manzanillo Power Land' combined-cycle power plant — fed by regasified LNG from the FSRU — was inaugurated on 27 March 2026, the largest single power-generation addition in the Caribbean in over a decade. The U.S. EIA's 2025 Caribbean LNG analysis lists Manzanillo among the Dominican Republic's operating regasification terminals, operating under a three-year charter pending a second onshore unit expected around 2027.
